sections.title: About Supcon
sections.text: Founded in 1993 in Hangzhou out of Zhejiang University, Supcon is listed on Shanghai's STAR Market and the SIX Swiss Exchange. In 2024 it held 40.4% of the Chinese DCS market and ranked first in domestic SIS for three years running.

sections.title: Platforms we deploy
rows: 65,000 I/O per control domain, up to 60 domains. OPC, Modbus, HART, FF, Profibus
IEC 61508, TÜV Rheinland SIL 3, triple modular redundancy

sections.title: What the partnership covers
sections.text: As an authorized channel partner we size, supply, engineer, commission and support Supcon platforms in Bangladesh — not just resell them. That means local application engineering, configuration and graphics, FAT and SAT, on-site commissioning and a first line of technical support from engineers who have deployed these systems in the field.

sections.title: The platform is a partnership. The expertise is ours.
sections.text: Supcon is who we partner with today. It is not the limit of what we can do: we have also delivered on ABB, Rockwell, Allen-Bradley and Honeywell platforms.

items.title: ECS-700 DCS
items.text: Distributed control for continuous process plants — redundant controllers, deterministic I/O and integrated historian for gas processing and compression.

items.title: TCS-900 SIS
items.text: Safety instrumented system to IEC 61508 / 61511, built for SIL-rated emergency shutdown, fire & gas and burner management duties.

items.title: Nyx UCS
items.text: Universal control system that converges DCS, PLC and SIS functions on one engineering environment for smaller or hybrid plants.

sections.title: Engineered and commissioned locally
sections.subtitle: Supcon is the platform; the configuration, graphics and start-up are ours.
paragraphs: Our engineers build the control narrative, I/O database and operator graphics, run factory and site acceptance tests, and lead commissioning and operator training — so the plant is handed over running, with a team in-country that knows the system.
